verdict.rationale: The official tools guide lists "remote MCP servers" as a first-party way to extend model capabilities, alongside built-in tools and function calling. It also says tools can be used to "access third-party services", so plugging MCP servers in to use their tools is a documented capability. Missing for 10: detailed setup, auth and tool-approval documentation for MCP connections; any evidence for local or stdio MCP servers rather than remote only; independent or hands-on corroboration that MCP tool use works in practice.
